entities.summary: Sang Thong, The Prince of the Golden Conch Shell or Phra Sang Thong is a Southeast Asian folktale inspired from the Paññāsa Jātaka, this wisdom book that is a canonical collection of ancient tales told in Thailand. In its Thai version, it tells the story of a prince who acquires a golden countenance, dons a disguise, marries a princess and saves the kingdom of his father-in-law.
